odc_type: infinite loop due to numerical stagnation
observation_summary: The solver throws a TooManyEvaluationsException because it enters an infinite loop where it repeatedly evaluates the same point.
reasoning_summary: The Regula Falsi algorithm, when implemented with finite-precision floating-point arithmetic, can encounter a scenario where the update formula produces a value identical to one of the existing bounds. This results in the algorithm repeatedly evaluating the same point without narrowing the interval, leading to an infinite loop that eventually exhausts the evaluation budget. The fix introduces a check for this stagnation and forces a small shift in the interval bounds to ensure progress, effectively preventing the infinite loop.
